coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 2 of 7 ground-truth variable items (29%): the two baseline prompts and coverage of all 23 BBH tasks. The remaining items are missing or materially different.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Replaces prompt optimization using PaLM 2-L-IT and text-bison with evaluation of a fixed instruction on LLaMA-3-70B-Instruct. Omits the 20% optimization/80% testing split, optimization from an empty instruction, and final training accuracy comparisons. Although per-task accuracy differences are measured, the specified >5% improvement in 19 or 20 tasks is replaced by non-negative differences in at least 16 tasks.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Fails to state that optimized instructions should outperform the baselines by over 5% on most tasks, supporting OPRO's superiority over standard or naive instructions.
